instruction: A glossy inflatable pool-float flamingo with a plump air-filled body, tucked legs, S-curved neck and a stylized beak. Taut shiny pink PVC with bright specular highlights and puffy welded seams.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE inflatable pool flamingo in a glossy inflatable pool float style. A glossy inflatable pool-float flamingo with a plump air-filled body, tucked legs, S-curved neck and a stylized beak. Taut shiny pink PVC with bright specular highlights and puffy welded seams. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
